import collections

int cross(int[] o, int[] a, int[] b)
    return (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0])

int[][] chain(int[][] points)
    int[][] result := []
    for point := points[]
        while #result >= 2 and cross(result[-2], result[-1], point) <= 0
            .result.take()
        .result.push(point)
    return result

int[][] points := [
    [3, 2], [-6, 1], [8, 4], [0, 0], [-3, 7], [4, -3], [1, -5], [-2, 1], [5, 6], [-6, -2], [2, -2],
    [7, -1], [-3, 4], [2, 8], [-6, 3],
]
points = points[collections.lex_order(points)]
lower := chain(points)
upper := chain(points[::-1])
.lower.take()
.upper.take()
hull := lower.concat(upper)
println("hull: {#hull} points")
twice_area := 0
for: i < #hull
    j := (i + 1) % #hull
    twice_area += hull[i][0] * hull[j][1] - hull[j][0] * hull[i][1]
    println("({hull[i][0]}, {hull[i][1]})")
area := real(twice_area) / 2.0
println("area: {area:.1}")
